Hi Jordan / AWS team,

Thanks for agreeing to explore a joint marketplace + SI demo. BlueWave and Redwood have a lot of overlap in our joint customers, and AWS asked us to run a short, focused session that shows:

- Marketplace listing & procurement flow (20 mins)
- SI integration patterns and reference architecture (15 mins)
- Live demo: deployment, a short inference walk-through, perf/latency expectations (20 mins)

Total goal: 60 minutes + 10 for Q&A.

Two asks from our side:
1) Can you share preferred timezones/windows (Jordan) next week or the week after?
2) Karthik / Sergio — want to confirm Redwood attendee list (PM, technical lead, and solutions engineer) and whether we can run a short pre-call for runbook items.

I've attached a first-pass runbook and a proposed availability ICS — feel free to edit.

Thanks,
